topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I got a message outta nowhere. One of those online types I used to banter with, turns out they're in the same godforsaken city as me. Small world, huh? They want to grab a coffee, like there's nothing wrong with that. Like we didn't just exist in a digital void for months. Now, I’m supposed to treat this like it’s a normal thing, a coincidence. I’ve seen how coincidences work; they’re rarely what they seem. So, I’m meeting them, but I’m keeping my eyes peeled. Ain’t nobody gonna fool me with a friendly smile and a hot beverage. I’ve been around the block a few times, seen the deals, the double-crosses. This one’s got a story, and I’m going to find out what it is.
